description: This file defines the ManufacturerDescription entity class, which models the description details for a manufacturer, including URL, click statistics, and last click date, with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: ManufacturerDescription
classes.description: Entity class representing the description of a manufacturer, including URL, click statistics, and association with the Manufacturer entity.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the manufacturer description.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL associated with the manufacturer description.

methods.name: getUrlClicked
methods.description: Returns the number of times the URL was clicked.

methods.name: setUrlClicked
methods.description: Sets the number of times the URL was clicked.

methods.name: getDateLastClick
methods.description: Returns the date of the last click.

methods.name: setDateLastClick
methods.description: Sets the date of the last click.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Returns the Manufacturer associated with this description.

methods.name: setManufacturer
methods.description: Associates a Manufacturer with this description.
